arrange.label: Arrangement
arrange.note: How the photographs are laid out. On a phone two of them sit in a short strip above the words, whichever you pick.

stack.label: Stacked
stack.note: The photographs overlap in a staggered cluster beside the words, the largest at the back. The default.

prints.label: Prints
prints.note: The photographs sit in a row as framed prints, each turned a little, above the words, which are centred.

side.label: Photo side
side.note: Which side the stacked photographs sit on when there is room for two columns. Prints always sit above the words.

end.label: Photos on the right
end.note: The words first, then the photographs. The default.

start.label: Photos on the left
start.note: The photographs first, then the words. Use it to swap sides with a photograph further down the page.

ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour behind this section. Change it between one section and the next so the page reads as bands instead of one flat colour.

plain.label: Default
plain.note: The page's own background colour. Quiet, and the right choice for most pages.

soft.label: Light
soft.note: A soft tint, to set the opener apart from the section under it.

brand.label: Brand colour
brand.note: Your brand colour, with text chosen to stay readable on it. Best used once or twice a page, not on everything.

deep.label: Dark
deep.note: A dark band. The boldest option, and the one that loses its impact if you use it more than once.
